أرتوي (form VIII)
# أَرْتَوِي (ʔartawī) /ʔar.ta.wiː/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِرْتَوَى (irtawā)
# أَرْتَوِيَ (ʔartawiya) /ʔar.ta.wi.ja/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَوَى (irtawā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
